title: Issue #17631 RTPS Group GUID dissector bug field rtps.param.group_guid is not of type FT_BYTES
description:
Update to packet-rtps.c fixes Issue #17631 RTPS Group GUID dissector bug field rtps.param.group_guid is not of type FT_BYTES.
It looks like Group GUID was overlooked when other GUID handlers were updated for V2 in commit ccb936eca508a586d9f5c5595615eab0bdc53098

commits_data.title: RTPS: Fix Group GUID dissector bug.
commits_data.message:
RTPS: Fix Group GUID dissector bug.

Dissector was not correctly distinguishing between 12 byte and 16 byte Group GUIDs.
Code for dissecting Participant GUID used as guidance.
closes #17631.
